name: United Stables
oneLiner: U is a BVI-issued dollar stablecoin backed by a variable mix of cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and approved fiat-referenced stablecoins.
collateral: Variable reserve mix of cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and fiat-referenced stablecoins approved by United Stables.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed minting against eligible assets and redemption for issuer-selected cash or stablecoins, restricted to approved Mint Users. Ethereum/BSC token owners can mint without a reserve-oracle check; Chainlink publishes aggregate reserve data.

proofOfReserves.provider: Chainlink U Reserves feed on BNB Chain (0xFa8e834DD2200923C706e6438d9030dB029B0c18; reference data directory identifies Stablemint Labs, third-party off-chain reserves, 18 decimals and an 86,400-second heartbeat). Ceffu separately provides digital-asset custody and MirrorX settlement; custody is not reserve-to-liability assurance.

latestReport.reviewer: FD24 bottom-up refinement 2026-10-20: September Moore CPA ISAE 3000 limited-assurance report reviewed, including scanned pages 1-5; four-network supply reconciled. Moore signed October 7; board approval signed October 8 is the conservative publication-date stand-in. No audit opinion, future liquidity or stablecoin/RWUSD par-value assurance is claimed.
